note: Money (Dave 2026-10-21). Coins never lie in the pack as stacks: they live in the purse (characters.json `coins`, the whole purse as a number of COPPER) and the purse is shown as copper, bronze, silver and gold, richest first. Ladder: 1 bronze = 10 copper, 1 silver = 10 bronze, 1 gold = 10 silver. The `value` of every item in items.json is in COPPER, so a stone axe (20) is two bronze and an iron pickaxe (120) is a silver and two bronze. Giving an item named coin_* (dialogue give_item, rewards, admin give) pays into the purse and shows in the 'you got' feed as that coin. Price anchors and wages are in items/COINS.md.

trade.note: Shop trading (Dave 2026-10-21): traders sell at a markup over an item's value and buy at a discount. Your standing with that trader moves both: shift = rep_rank_index x rep_step + charisma x charisma_step + luck x luck_strength x luck_share (luck_strength is the 0.04 per point of the luck system). The trader charges value x (sell_markup - shift), never under min_sell, and pays value x (buy_discount + shift), never over max_buy, so buying never costs less than selling back (min_sell > max_buy). Prices are rounded (charged up, paid down) and a paid price is at least 1 copper for anything worth a copper or more. A damaged tool is paid for in proportion to its remaining life; rotten food and worthless things are not bought.

demand.note: A trader's demand for an item falls as you sell it: each unit sold lowers what they pay for that item by drop_per_sale (of the base price), never under floor, and it comes back recover_per_min sales a minute. It stops selling endless sticks for a fortune. Shared by everyone at that trader.

stock.note: Trader stock (build 576): each stocked item has a maximum and a restock rate per game day (a game day is one real hour); shops.json stock_rules [max, per_day] overrides default_max and default_per_day. Supply moves the price you pay: a full shelf is cheaper by strength x 0.5, an empty one dearer by strength x 0.5, kept between min and max. Items you sell that the trader stocks go back on the shelf. A trader can only pay out its purse: purse_cap_default and purse_regen_default per game day, shops.json purse_cap and purse_regen_per_day override.

repair.note: A smith with 'repairs': true in shops.json mends a worn or broken tool for value x rate x the share of durability used x the stranger/reputation pay multiple; the tool comes back as new.

sell_extras.note: The one-click 'Would you like to buy my extra stuff?' sale (Dave 2026-10-22): sells every stack of these kinds worth less than valuable_from copper each. Tools, weapons, coins, gear, clothing, kits and anything worth more are never swept; sell those one by one.
